description: This file defines types, function prototypes, and macros related to collecting results from worker contexts within the lighttpd server framework. It includes definitions for callback function signatures, start functions for initiating collection processes, and internal control functions.

methods.name: li_collect_start
methods.description: Starts a collection process in a specific worker context, executing a callback in each worker and returning a liCollectInfo handle.

methods.name: li_collect_start_global
methods.description: Initiates collection across the main server worker, suitable for global collection tasks.

methods.name: li_collect_break
methods.description: Terminates an ongoing collection process prematurely.

ctags.name: liCollectCB

ctags.typeref: typename:void (*)(liWorker * wrk,gpointer cbdata,gpointer fdata,GPtrArray * result,gboolean complete)
